name: Integration - Anthropic Provider API Key Validation
description: Ensures that the Config class raises a ValueError if the Anthropic API key is missing when Anthropic is the provider.
input: Environment variable LLM_PROVIDER set to 'anthropic' and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset.
output: ValueError is raised indicating missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
error_scenarios: No error is raised when API key is missing
